label: Ukraine reports first Shahed-136 shoot-down
description: Ukraine's armed forces said they had, for the first time, shot down an Iranian drone, near Kupiansk. Coverage identified it as a Shahed-136.
notes: This is the first reported shoot-down; the date of first use is not established. It is before the strike data starts (2022-09-28).

label: Strikes damage energy facilities
description: The UN human rights office reported that missile attacks damaged or destroyed at least 12 energy facilities in eight regions.
notes: The briefing note is dated 11 Oct and says 'yesterday'. Neither opened page calls 10 Oct the start of a campaign, so the label does not either. A UN monitoring update that might was refused by the server (HTTP 403) and was not read.

date_marks: Pause confirmed by the White House
label: US pauses military aid to Ukraine
description: The White House confirmed that the United States had paused military aid to Ukraine while reviewing it.
notes: Neither 3 Mar page confirms that intelligence sharing was paused that day. The CBS page shows only an 'updated' time stamp.

label: US lifts pause on military aid and intelligence sharing
description: The United States lifted its suspension of military aid and intelligence sharing for Ukraine after talks in Jeddah.
notes: AP report. The State Department statement was refused by the server (HTTP 403) and was not read.

label: Air Force confirms limits on missile figures
description: Ukraine's Air Force confirmed that it had stopped publishing some missile counts, including ballistic missiles launched and intercepted during massive attacks.
notes: This marks the confirmation, not the first affected data. LIGA says the report for 9 Aug already had no count (Meduza, citing Strana, also gives 9 Aug). LIGA says cruise missiles are affected too, as does KAS Monitor Vol. XX. The data flag's start date is open in docs/plan.md section 11.

label: Two-level air-raid alerts adopted
description: Cabinet Resolution No. 1092 set two alert levels: yellow for a drone threat and red for a missile, missile-drone or massive drone threat.
notes: Announced 2 Sept (https://www.kyivpost.com/post/83601). Rollout dates differed by place. UNN: Kyiv began 6 Sept, not in all districts. Lviv began 12 Oct (https://inkorr.com/en/u-lvovi-z-12-zovtna-vvodat-dva-rivni-povitranoi-trivogi-zovtij-i-cervonij-350286). No opened page gives a national effective date. Resolution text copy: https://docs.dtkt.ua/doc/1092-2026-%D0%BF (not a government site); amended by No. 1128 of 15 Sept. zakon.rada.gov.ua refused the fetch. Whether alert data carries levels belongs to issue 2.

label: Oreshnik missile used against Lviv target
description: The KAS monitor reports that an Oreshnik missile was used against an aircraft maintenance facility in Lviv on the night of January 9.
notes: One source. 'Night of January 9' has not been matched to the end-date night key.

label: Oreshnik missile strikes Bila Tserkva
description: The KAS monitor reports that an Oreshnik strike hit Bila Tserkva on the night of May 24, using only non-explosive payloads.
notes: One source. 'Night of 24 May' has not been matched to the end-date night key.

date_marks: First day of a two-day event
label: Attack series lasting more than 28 hours
description: The KAS monitor reports a combined series of drone and missile attacks on August 28 and 29 that lasted more than 28 hours and set off 28 air-raid alerts.
notes: One source. The Vol. XX summary ties the long waves to Kyiv. Confirm the area, and compare with the alert data, before showing it.

label: Earlier Oreshnik use (November 2024)
description: The KAS monitor says the missile had previously been used against Ukraine in November 2024.
notes: The opened page gives only the month. Needs a source with the day.

label: Record of 948 drones in 24 hours
description: Two issues of the KAS monitor give different dates for a 24-hour record of 948 drones.
notes: Vol. XVI says 23-24 March (no year printed); Vol. XVII says 24 April 2026. Check against the strike data. Record nights are probably better derived from the data than annotated.
